authority: Map supplies physical geography; Gameplay populates and simulates it.

spawnSelection.rule: Deterministic sum of nearby authored roads/POIs/zones/bridges/docks/rivers within fixed radii; tie-break by nearest road. No preference or invented weight.
spawnSelection.why: sp_lake has the most authored geographic support: 23 roads, 12 POIs, 10 buildable zones, 6 bridges, 4 docks and 4 rivers in range.

targetSelection.rule: Existing POI shell with >=2 authored road-graph edges and straight-line distance <=300 au; ranked by edge count then authored route length.

initialTerrain.note: RELATIVE candidate selection only (lowest raw-slope quartile of nearby walkable cells). No absolute safe-slope/safety threshold is authored in Veyra; Gameplay owns that rule. These are NOT spawn points.

resourceGeography.note: These are the EXISTING Veyra geographic annotations with source ids preserved. No new resource position, stock, yield, respawn or loot was placed. Gameplay generates harvestables from suitability areas.

buildSites.note: Multiple candidate buildable regions with measured clearance. A0 protection, collision, occupancy and route legality remain Gameplay/A0-owned.

primary.label: Authored cart corridor via the br_4 river crossing
primary.note: All segment points are verbatim authored road vertices or exact segment intersections. Straight connectors are DERIVED and must be checked against the physical land mask.

return.note: Same authored geometry reversed. A physically distinct return is RT-2 / RT-3.

alternatives.label: Same corridor without the alt detour rd_1w (full rd_13)
alternatives.note: All segment points are verbatim authored road vertices or exact segment intersections. Straight connectors are DERIVED and must be checked against the physical land mask.

alternatives.label: Riverside path rd_20 (Greywater West Bank Path)
alternatives.note: All segment points are verbatim authored road vertices or exact segment intersections. Straight connectors are DERIVED and must be checked against the physical land mask.

routes.note: RT-1/RT-2 differ by the authored alt detour rd_1w; RT-3 uses the authored riverside path rd_20 with explicitly reported derived connectors. No new geometry was invented.

grid.order: row_major: i = gy*gw + gx; cell centre = [(gx+0.5)*cell, (gy+0.5)*cell]

physicalConnectivity.passableRule: walkableCandidate=1 OR (river centreline cell AND authored crossingCandidate>0)
physicalConnectivity.note: Grid-step distance is a 4-neighbour raster lower bound in authoring units (cells x 8), NOT the authored polyline length and NOT a travel-time measurement. Clearance is derived BFS distance to the nearest blocked cell.

dependencies.ferryNote: Ferry paths exist elsewhere in Veyra but NONE lies on RT-1/RT-2/RT-3. Boarding/boat rules are UNDEFINED and no ferry was substituted with a land road.
unresolved: rv_silver / rv_grey_low width field has no established physical unit; only centreline cells are treated as channel.
br_4 (load:cart) and br_a (load:foot) channel span fit is UNVERIFIED; loaded-cart grade limits are Gameplay rules.
Slope is a raw byte gradient (1..4, mean 2.0323); no passable threshold is authored.
Ferry boarding / boat / portage rules are UNDEFINED and 8 ferry paths exist elsewhere in Veyra.
Travel time t_foot / t_cart_loaded / exposure_time requires an approved world-scale transform and measured journeys.
POI interior (rooms, doors, sockets, power, loot) is NOT_IN_SOURCE / Gameplay-owned.
Climate, hazard intensity and dynamic occupancy are UNDEFINED.

survivability.statement: This is a physical geography proof only. The corridor is NOT claimed to be naturally survivable: Gameplay has not run its actual population algorithm, source placement, survival rules, day/night, weather, hunger/thirst, creature threat, inventory carrying cost or 14-day clock. A static corridor diagram is not gameplay validation.

visualInspection.note: Vector/PNG inspection of ACTUAL Veyra polygons, polylines and the routed corridor. Not a game screenshot, not an art proposal, not gameplay validation.
